claims.text: Topical nitroglycerin 0.2% ointment, nifedipine 0.2% cream or diltiazem 2% gel, or onabotulinumtoxinA injected into the internal sphincter, relax the anal sphincter and lower resting pressure so the fissure can heal.
claims.quote: Topical nitroglycerin 0.2% ointment, nifedipine 0.2% cream, and diltiazem 2% gel or injections of onabotulinumtoxinA into the internal sphincter relax the anal sphincter and decrease maximum anal resting pressure, allowing healing.

claims.text: If conservative measures fail, internal anal sphincterotomy.
claims.quote: When conservative measures fail, surgery (internal anal sphincterotomy) is needed
